A_feature_availability.rule: Every 1s bar feature at relative second t uses ts_init <= (event_ts + t*1e9)

B_no_future_extrema.rule: Running regime extreme is updated sequentially up to second t; future extrema after t are never used

C_no_completed_run_labels_in_features.rule: Winning run duration and outcome labels are used strictly as evaluation targets and never passed into X

D_chronological_split_integrity.rule: Diagnostic model trained on 2023-2024 TRAIN only; 2025 Q1 OOS strictly untouched during feature construction and fitting

E_native_1s_unfilled_catalog.rule: 1-second bars sourced from immutable NQ_1S_V2_GLOBEX catalog with native rows only
